items.q: How do you think Ray Charles (inaudible) got a hit?

ctx.x: : There's six albums there from Norman Grantz recorded on tour this summer, all jam sessions, you know? And it's --
They make a little money on them, some kind of way, but I don't want to (inaudible). How do you think Ray Charles (inaudible) got a hit? (Inaudible). I'm telling you, he had a band.
